cross_version_observations.what: After the update, the two settings Apple's September text used to define 'Siri off' were still off, but iOS 27 added a separate 'Turn Off Siri' control that the user had not used.
cross_version_observations.before: iOS 26.7.1: Talk to Siri — Off; Press Side Button for Siri — off (O002, O007). Apple's September text defines turning Siri off as exactly these two (sources.json E01).
cross_version_observations.after: iOS 27.2: the same two settings still off, now under Requests (O105). Settings > Siri shows a row labelled 'Turn Off Siri' (O102).

quotes: To turn off Siri, go to Settings > Siri > Turn Off Siri, then tap Turn Off Siri.
Tap Turn Off Siri at the bottom, then tap Turn Off Siri.
apple_text.claude_note: By Apple's iOS 27 wording, turning Siri off is done with this control, which the user had not used. Apple does not say what state the phone treats Siri as being in, or that the label shows the state. Claude's earlier reading (label shows Siri as on) was an inference and is withdrawn as a statement of fact.

cross_version_observations.user_statement: The user had Siri off before updating and did not turn it on (2026-11-03).
cross_version_observations.not_stated_by_apple: How the update treats a user who had Siri off by the earlier definition; whether Siri counts as on or off before 'Turn Off Siri' is tapped.

revised.reason: Independent check: the original wording stated as fact what Apple's text does not say; the quoted 'Turn On Siri' sentence is about Siri AI devices.

was.what: Siri off before the update; Apple's new main Siri control shows Siri as on after it.
was.before: iOS 26.7.1: Talk to Siri — Off; Press Side Button for Siri — off (O002, O007). Apple's September text defines turning Siri off as exactly these two (sources.json E01).
was.after: iOS 27.2: the same two settings still off, now under Requests (O105); Settings > Siri shows a 'Turn Off Siri' button (O102).

apple_text.quote: If you have Siri AI but want to use the previous version of Siri, tap Turn On Siri, then tap Use Siri Classic.
apple_text.claude_note: Apple labels the button 'Turn On Siri' when Siri is off, so a 'Turn Off Siri' label indicates the phone treats Siri as on. Claude's reading.

was.user_statement: The user had Siri off before updating and did not turn it on (2026-11-03).
was.not_stated_by_apple: How the update sets the new main control for a user who had Siri off before.
